svg.title: Impact
svg.desc: Agent platform: 4 clouds, 1 platform, EKS, AKS, GKE, on-prem tenant isolation · RBAC; −40% manual ops, harness + checkpoint recovery on agent runs; 10K+ daily recalls, persistent agent memory Graphiti · Postgres; +35% continuity, long-horizon reasoning across sessions; Weeks → days, new-agent onboarding 6 frameworks, one API. Autonomous agents: Notebook agents, create/complete/delete Jupyter, end to end; Workspace agents, Teradata workspace integration via harness; Scheduled agents, cron + event triggers retries · resume; SDLC agents, PR review · features e2e pipeline tests; Full-stack features, React · TypeScript UI Go · Python services. Evals · routing · deploy: −50% debugging, Opik + OpenTelemetry traces on every run; +70% traceability, structured traces solve rate · failures; Right model per task, eval-based routing AutoLLM · cost/latency; +55% consistency, deploys across clusters KServe · NIM · Helm; Deploy anywhere, automated rollout to any cluster or on-prem. Healthcare ai: 60M+ claims, 3-month cost of care forecast · anomalies; 48% → 81%, member risk coverage 15x targeted outreach; $1M+ a year, clinical risk models underwriting value; 91% clinical QA, LLaMA-2 · RAG · QLoRA 3x lower inference cost; $300K saved, recurring high-cost claimant prediction. Data & nlp: 95% NL2SQL, fine-tuned LLM + knowledge graph; −31% latency, vs manual SQL workflow baseline; 8–10 FTEs saved, ticket triage BERT · XGBoost; RMSE 9.05, claims forecasting Prophet · SARIMA; 82% ROUGE-L, 500+ summaries query-based NLP. Research: 99.3% detection, ransomware quality IEEE VLSID 2024; 530 ms to detect, decoy files + inode monitoring; 98 ms to contain, 35 of 5,000 files lost, at most; +23% relevance, multilingual retrieval BM25 · Indic-BERT; −45% query time, 50K+ documents Indian-language IR.
